id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

exceptionReason.description: why is this time window is an exception to a standard calendar?

startDatetime.description:
Start date and time of day this exception begins, inclusive
Typical use is work hours start time for a day

endDatetime.description:
End date and time of day this exception ends, exclusive
00:00 start and end time on the same day implies no time for the day

title:
A window of time that may span multiple days associated to a schedule that overrides
and time calculated from the ScheduleRecurringDayRule or Holidays associated to a schedule
Initial use is exceptions to standard daily time schedule defined by
rules set up in scheduleRecurringDayRule.
00:00 to 00:00 on the same date implies no hours
00:00 to 00:00 the next day implies all day
